selection.ownership: AlpacaDB, Inc. / Alpaca Securities LLC, San Mateo, California, United States (FINRA/SEC broker-dealer). The reviewed edition is the public international Trading API at paper-api.alpaca.markets and api.alpaca.markets, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Alpaca Trading API authentication (APCA-API-KEY-ID + APCA-API-SECRET-KEY), paper vs live hosts, GET /v2/account, GET /v2/assets, GET /v2/positions, GET /v2/clock, GET /v2/watchlists, Alpaca Securities LLC San Mateo identity, and dated incident search for Alpaca Markets / Alpaca Securities security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. Status-page HTTP 500 / market-data duplication events are availability, not customer-data compromise. No qualifying current unresolved customer-data compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Alpaca key-id/secret headers, paper-api.alpaca.markets and api.alpaca.markets, GET /v2/account validator, Trading API reads, San Mateo broker-dealer identity, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. Status-page events are availability only.

incidents.finding: Bounded search of Alpaca Markets / Alpaca Securities security breach coverage on 2026-09-13 identified API latency and a 2025-12-15 Broker API resource-exhaustion postmortem that stated no client funds or trading data were lost. No current unresolved customer-data compromise was identified.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /v2/account used by the pinned validator.

Required stored tradingHost interpolates https://{{tradingHost}}.alpaca.markets with allowedHosts limited to paper-api.alpaca.markets and api.alpaca.markets (Algolia-style). Source environment paper|live cannot interpolate those hostnames, so tradingHost is paper-api or api.

API secret is setup apiKey as APCA-API-SECRET-KEY; API key ID is a required stored header APCA-API-KEY-ID. OAuth is omitted. Returns raw account JSON under data instead of {account}. Upstream user-agent is not sent.
Maps to official GET /v2/assets. Optional status and assetClass bind to status and asset_class. attributes comma-join is omitted because native query templates would emit repeated keys.
Returns the raw JSON array under data instead of {assets}.
Maps to official GET /v2/positions. Returns the raw JSON array under data instead of {positions}.
Maps to official GET /v2/clock. Returns raw clock JSON under data instead of {clock}.
Maps to official GET /v2/watchlists. Returns the raw JSON array under data instead of {watchlists}. Market-data host data.alpaca.markets is omitted.
Maps to official GET /v2/assets/{symbol_or_asset_id}. Returns raw JSON under data.
Maps to official GET /v2/positions/{symbol_or_asset_id}. Returns raw JSON under data.
Official DELETE /v2/positions/{symbol_or_asset_id} with optional qty or percentage. Native templates cannot express one-of qty/percentage exclusivity.
Maps to official GET /v2/orders. symbols is a comma-separated query string rather than a repeated key.
Maps to official GET /v2/orders/{order_id}. client_order_id lookup is omitted because native templates cannot express one-of path switching.
Official POST /v2/orders. qty and notional are both optional in the native schema because one-of cannot be expressed; the provider rejects invalid combinations.
Official DELETE /v2/orders/{order_id} answers 204 No Content. Native data is null on success.
Maps to official GET /v2/watchlists/{watchlist_id}. Name lookup is omitted because native templates cannot express one-of path switching.
Official POST /v2/watchlists with name and optional symbols array.
Maps to official GET /v2/calendar. Returns the raw JSON array under data.
Maps to official GET /v2/account/activities. activityTypes is a comma-separated query string. activityTypes and category exclusivity is left to the provider.
Maps to official GET /v2/account/configurations. Returns raw JSON under data.
Maps to official GET /v2/account/portfolio/history. cashflowTypes comma-join is omitted.
Maps to official GET /v2/options/contracts on the trading host. underlyingSymbols is a comma-separated query string.
Maps to official GET /v2/options/contracts/{symbol_or_id}.
